messages.content:
Reply with one JSON object only, matching this JSON schema:
{"description": "A technical dimension drawing: the labelled measurements in centimetres.", "properties": {"width_cm": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "depth_cm": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "height_cm": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}]}, "seat_height_cm": {"anyOf": [{"type": "number"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "null if the drawing does not show it"}, "product_code": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "description": "code printed on the drawing, if any"}}, "required": ["width_cm", "depth_cm", "height_cm", "seat_height_cm", "product_code"], "type": "object"}

content.text: This is a technical dimension drawing of a piece of furniture, in centimetres. Read the labelled dimensions: overall width, depth and height, and the seat height if it is shown. Use null for a dimension that is not labelled.
